record_type_quote: This paper presents a replication of one such study conducted by Zimmermann and Nagappan on Windows Server 2003 where the authors leveraged dependency relationships between software entities captured using social network metrics to predict whether they are likely to have defects.

targets.evidence_quote: This paper presents a replication of one such study conducted by Zimmermann and Nagappan on Windows Server 2003 where the authors leveraged dependency relationships between software entities captured using social network metrics to predict whether they are likely to have defects.
targets.outcome_quote: Our results are in agreement with the original study by Zimmermann and Nagappan when using a similar experimental setup as them (random sampling). However, when we evaluated the metrics using setups more suited for industrial use -- forward-release and cross-project prediction -- we found network metrics to offer no vantage over code metrics.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The same experimental setup agrees with the original; forward-release and cross-project tests do not retain the original advantage of network metrics. Abstract lacks full target citation.
